project.name: cavet
project.description: A Go CLI security-triage tool for coding agents. It runs scanners (trivy, opengrep, gitleaks, checkov) inside an offline container engine and records every finding and decision in an append-only audit log.
project.context: This finding comes from a scan of the cavet repository itself.

finding.description:
requests: subsequent requests to the same host ignore cert verification
verdict: dismissed (high confidence, by operator): deliberate vulnerable fixture under internal/finding/testdata/fixture/requirements.txt consumed by scanner tests; not imported by production code
